messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to lock the rollout plan for the Priority Tenant cutover and surge-protection behavior. Major customers start onboarding next week, and sales asks for a clear canary + fallback ladder.

mohit: Ack. I sketched a phasing doc. Main goals: avoid noisy neighbor impact, keep p95 latency under 300ms for priority tenants, and ensure zero customer-visible errors on failover.

jess: Proposed approach (lightweight): staged canary by region + tenant-priority buckets + automated fallback to last-stable model/region. Minimal scope: feature flag + canary cohort + traffic steering policy.

sam: +1. Can we keep initial sfx to 5% priority-tenant traffic in region, then 25%, then 100%? Also want automatic rollback triggers for error-rate or latency.

jess: Exactly. Suggested thresholds: error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 increase > 30% over baseline for 3m => immediate rollback/failover.

lina: Ops notes: add circuit-breaker that routes to fallback pool (lower-cost replica) and emits an incident event. We'll need a short TTL before re-trying to prevent flapping. Suggest 10m cool-off.

elaine: Can someone paste the flag config we'll use? Keep it small so engineering can implement fast.

jess: Draft flag payload (will be stored in LaunchDarkly):

```
{
  "flagKey": "priority_cutover_v1",
  "buckets": [
    {"name": "control","pct": 70},
    {"name": "canary-small","pct": 5, "tenants": ["test-*"]},
    {"name": "priority-ps1","pct": 25, "tenants": ["tenant-A","tenant-B"]}
  ],
  "autoRollback": {
    "errRateThreshold": 0.005,
    "p95IncreasePct": 30,
    "windowMins": 5
  }
}
```

mosh: (note: mosh is not in participants; ignore)

mohit: Implementation notes: router needs to support per-tenant pinning + realtime change of bucket weights. We already have that in traffic-router v2 but need a quick API toggle. Engineering estimate: 2 dev days + 1 day ops validation.

sam: Testing matrix: 1) shadow traffic for 24h for region-us-east, 2) small canary (5%) for 1h with synthetic load, 3) 25% for 3h with live traffic, then full cutover. Each step gated by telemetry checks.

lina: Add synthetic probes: burst test, KV cache hit ratio, and tail-latency percentiles. Also verify connection pool saturation on GPU nodes.

deploy-bot: deploy event: canary-service v2 deployed to us-east-1 at 2418002100 (build #1824). Logs: short warm-up OK.

jess: Rollback plan: immediate traffic revert to previous flag state + failover to regional fallback (us-west) if persistent. For tenant-sensitive flows, enable read-only mode on error to limit risk.

elaine: Launch criteria checklist (must-haves):
- monitoring dashboards for p50/p95/p99 + error-rate (done)
- automated rollback triggers wired (ops)
- routing API to change buckets in <30s
- canary runbook and on-call owner assigned

mohit: Owners: Mohit (engineer), Lina (oncall ops), Sam (QA). I'll file a short playbook doc and link it in #incidents.

sam: One product question: do we include an A/B for quantization changes during cutover? That would affect quality. My vote: keep model variant constant during initial cutover; schedule A/B after stable for 2 weeks.

jess: Agreed. No model changes during cutover. Only routing/traffic changes. Separate experiment for quantization.

elainE: (typo) Elaine: Thanks — final ask: can we freeze any other non-essential deploys for the window? Prefer a 4h blackout around the 25% -> 100% step.

lina: Yep, ops will enforce a deploy freeze for that window.

elaine: Great. Action items: Mohit file playbook + runbook, Jess implement flag draft, Lina prepare probes and circuit-breaker, Sam run smoke + synthetic. We'll meet tomorrow 10:30 to confirm go/no-go. :thumbsup:

mohit: Filing docs now, will ping when ready.

jess: I'll drop the LD flag JSON in the infra repo and open a PR.

lina: I'll add dashboards and synthetic jobs.

deploy-bot: scheduled incident-notification channel created: #incident-priority-cutover (members: mohit, lina, sam, jess, elaine)
